messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: realtime-streaming-api-eu p99 latency spike detected. 5m window p99=2.9s (>SLO 1.0s). Route: streaming-v2, affected traffic ~17%. Alert ID: ALRT-20260317-839
oncall-alex: Ack. Paging SRE Maya. I'll stand by in bridge. Can someone check recent deploys?
sre-maya: On it. looking at dashboards -> https://dash.redwood.ai/streams/streaming-v2?range=5m :eyes:
eng-runtime-jordan: FYI there was a canary rollout 3m ago (rev r12->r13) with optimized batching enabled.
oncall-alex: Deploy bot, status?
deploy-bot: Deploy r13 to streaming-v2 completed 2026-03-17T14:05Z. No automatic rollback.
sre-maya: Live tail shows spikes coincident with increased batch sizes and KV cache miss rate up ~22%.
support-lin: Customer impact: 3 support tickets in last 10m mentioning timeouts for streaming sessions. Severity: medium.
eng-runtime-jordan: Quick mitigation: disable adaptive-batching on r13 for routes streaming-v2 (low risk). Also bump pool size for eu-gpu-1 by +2.
oncall-alex: Can you patch now? If yes, do it and share commands.
eng-runtime-jordan: Patching:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/streaming-v2 ADAPTIVE_BATCHING=false --record
k8s-scale eu-gpu-1 --replicas +2
```
eng-runtime-jordan: Patch applied. Scaling started. Monitoring.
sre-maya: KV miss rate trending down, p99 dropping to ~1.1s after 45s :thumbsup: 
oncall-alex: Good. Keep watch. If p99 < 1.0s sustained for 5m we'll close the page.
support-lin: I'll update affected customers and add note to status page.
eng-runtime-jordan: Also rolling back r13 if we see any other regressions. If stable, we'll re-evaluate batching config offline.
incident-bot: Note: page created INC-5609, oncall: alex, responders: maya, jordan. Escalation timer set 20m.
oncall-alex: Leaving here; joining incident bridge #inc-5609-bridge. If anyone sees re-spike, ping @oncall-alex or call.
eng-runtime-jordan: monitoring → p99=0.92s now, p95=0.38s. Closing initial triage.
sre-maya: I'll prep post-mortem with quick checks: deploy diff, batching metrics, kvcache timeline.
oncall-alex: Thanks team. Moving to incident channel, leaving this thread.
